title: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports with admin_state
question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports with admin_state_up = 1, list each port’s ID, tenant ID, port name, host, VIF type, VNIC type, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type), along with the port’s security group binding count and total DNS record count. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.name AS port_name,
    b.host,
    b.vif_type,
    b.vnic_type,
    p.network_id,
    p.mac_address,
    p.status,
    p.device_owner,
    p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
    AND p.admin_state_up = 1
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    port_id, tenant_id, port_name, host, vif_type, vnic_type,
    network_id, mac_address, status, device_owner,
    AVG(standard_attr_id) OVER (
      PARTITION BY vif_type 
      ORDER BY standard_attr_id 
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS windowed_avg_standard_attr_id
  FROM base_ports
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS security_group_binding_count
  FROM securitygroupportbindings
  GROUP BY port_id
),
dns_counts AS (
  SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dns_record_count
  FROM portdnses
  GROUP BY port_id
)
SELECT 
  w.port_id,
  w.tenant_id,
  w.port_name,
  w.host,
  w.vif_type,
  w.vnic_type,
  w.network_id,
  w.mac_address,
  w.status,
  w.device_owner,
  w.windowed_avg_standard_attr_id,
  COALESCE(sg.security_group_binding_count, 0) AS security_group_binding_count,
  COALESCE(dns.total_dns_record_count, 0) AS total_dns_record_count
FROM windowed w
LEFT JOIN sg_counts sg ON sg.port_id = w.port_id
LEFT JOIN dns_counts dns ON dns.port_id = w.port_id

SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name, b.host, b.vif_type, b.vnic_type, p.network_id, p.mac_address, p.status, p.device_owner,
AVG(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS windowed_avg,
sgc.sg_count, d.dns_count
FROM ports p
LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_count FROM securitygroupportbindings GROUP BY port_id) sgc ON sgc.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS dns_count FROM portdnses GROUP BY port_id) d ON d.port_id = p.id
WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p.admin_state_up = 1

),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    port_id, tenant_id, port_name, host, vif_type, vnic_type,
    network_id, mac_address, status, device_owner,
    AVG(standard_attr_id) OVER (
      PARTITION BY vif_type 
      ORDER BY standard_attr_id

    ) AS windowed_avg_standard_attr_id
  FROM base_ports
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS security_group_binding_count
  FROM securitygroupportbindings
  GROUP BY port_id
),
dns_counts AS (
  SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dns_record_count
  FROM portdnses
  GROUP BY port_id
)

  w.port_name,
  w.host,

  w.vnic_type,
  w.network_id,
  w.mac_address,
  w.status,

LEFT JOIN dns_counts dns ON dns.port_id = w.port_id
